/-! ## The field certificate of an arbitrary adaptation -/

section Certificate

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
variable [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

namespace DivisorAdaptation

variable {d : (relCurve C K).LocalEquations} (A : DivisorAdaptation C K π d)

omit [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] in
/-- **(c1)-finiteness over a field, for an arbitrary adaptation**: each chart-local
colength module `Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_j)` is a finite `K`-module — the chart colength
reading (`moduleFinite_quotient_span_section`) on a nonempty piece, and the zero ring
on an empty piece. -/
theorem moduleFinite_colength (j : A.index) : Module.Finite K (A.colength j) := by
  by_cases hη : genericPoint (relCurve C K) ∈ A.pieces j
  · exact moduleFinite_quotient_span_section K (A.isAffineOpen_pieces j) hη
      (A.eqn_ne_zero j hη)
  · have hbot : A.pieces j ≤ ⊥ :=
      fun x hx => hη (Scheme.genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty ⟨x, hx⟩)
    haveI : Subsingleton Γ(relCurve C K, A.pieces j) :=
      (relCurve C K).subsingleton_sections_of_le_bot hbot
    haveI : Subsingleton (A.colength j) :=
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (I := Ideal.span {A.eqn j})).subsingleton
    haveI : Finite (A.colength j) := Finite.of_subsingleton
    exact Module.Finite.of_finite

/-- **The field certificate of an arbitrary adaptation** (the B-3 deviation of record,
superseding the worksheet's support-separated route): over the field `K`, an adaptation
of a system whose divisor has degree `n` is certified in degree `n`.  Every module over
`K` is free, so (c1)-projectivity and the flat-cokernel clauses (c3)/(c4) are instances;
(c1)-finiteness is `moduleFinite_colength`; and the (c2) rank is the unconditional CRT
colength↔degree identity (`DivisorAdaptation.deg_presentationDivisor`, I-0230) read
against the degree hypothesis. -/
theorem isCertified_of_deg {n : ℕ}
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K
      (Scheme.presentationDivisor K d.presentation) = (n : ℤ)) :
    A.IsCertified n := by
  haveI hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite K (A.colength j) := A.moduleFinite_colength
  haveI : Module.Finite K A.chartProd := Module.Finite.pi
  haveI : Module.Finite K A.Glued := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Free K A.Glued := Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
  have hfr : finrank K A.Glued = n := by
    have hZ := A.deg_presentationDivisor
    rw [hdeg] at hZ
    exact_mod_cast hZ.symm
  refine
    { finite_colength := hfin
      projective_colength := fun j =>
        haveI : Module.Free K (A.colength j) := Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
        inferInstance
      finite_glued := inferInstance
      projective_glued := inferInstance
      rankAtStalk_glued := fun p => ?_
      flat_coker_incl :=
        haveI : Module.Free K (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) :=
          Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
        inferInstance
      flat_coker_diff :=
        haveI : Module.Free K
            (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) :=
          Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
        inferInstance }
  simp [hfr]

    (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K D = (n : ℤ)) :
    ∃ F : DivFam C K π n, divFamDivisor F = D := by
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ :=
    Scheme.LocalEquations.exists_localEquations_presentationDivisor_eq K D hD
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := exists_divisorAdaptation C K π E
  refine ⟨DivFam.mk ⟨E, A, A.isCertified_of_deg (by rw [hE]; exact hdeg)⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [divFamDivisor_mk]
  exact hE

/-- **The field dictionary, unconditional** (the frozen `divFamFieldEquiv` of
`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 (f), both named gaps discharged): certified divisor families
of degree `n` over the field `K` are exactly the effective degree-`n` Weil divisors.
`hdeg` is the landed CRT identity (`deg_divFamDivisor`, I-0230); `hsurj` is the B-3
keystone above. -/
noncomputable def divFamFieldEquiv :
    DivFam C K π n ≃
      {D : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor //
        0 ≤ D ∧ Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K D = (n : ℤ)} :=
  divFamFieldEquivOfDegOfSurj (fun F => deg_divFamDivisor F)
    (fun D hD hdeg => exists_divFam_divFamDivisor_eq D hD hdeg)

@[simp]
lemma divFamFieldEquiv_apply (F : DivFam C K π n) :
    (divFamFieldEquiv F : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor) = divFamDivisor F :=
  rfl

end Certificate

/-!
# DAT-B B-3 — the `hsurj` completion and the field DivScheme-point

The field-dictionary completion of the DAT-B worksheet
(`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.7, COV-4): over a field `K`, every effective
degree-`n` Weil divisor on the relative curve is the divisor of a certified divisor
family (`exists_divFam_divFamDivisor_eq`, the `hsurj` slot of
`divFamFieldEquivOfDegOfSurj`), so the field dictionary closes unconditionally
(`divFamFieldEquiv`), and — through the landed F4 layer (`divRepClassifyZar`,
I-0243) — every effective degree-`g` divisor yields a `DivScheme`-point
`overSpec k K ⟶ divSchemeOver!` (`effectiveDivisorClassifyZar`), the worksheet §3.3
effectivity export DAT-J's quasi-compactness image argument consumes.

## Route, and the recorded deviation from the worksheet pin

* The anchor equations come from the landed backward realization
  `exists_localEquations_presentationDivisor_eq` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyBackward.lean`):
  a product of tracked point-uniformizer equations cutting exactly `D`.
* **Deviation (worksheet §1.7 / risk 5, superseded by I-0230):** the worksheet routes
  the certificate through a *support-separated* adaptation and
  `deg_divFamDivisor_of_separated`.  The landed CRT layer
  (`DivisorAdaptation.deg_presentationDivisor`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyFieldCRT.lean`,
  I-0230) computes `deg K (div d) = finrank K W(d)` for **every** adaptation with no
  separation hypothesis — and full support-separation is in fact unachievable when a
  support point lies in the overlap of the two pinned charts (each chart's partition
  forces its pieces to cover the whole chart, so such a point lies in one piece of
  *each* chart).  The certificate is therefore discharged on the plain extraction
  adaptation (`exists_divisorAdaptation`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyExtraction.lean`):
  over the field every module is free — (c1)-projective, (c3), (c4) are instances —
  (c1)-finiteness is the chart colength reading
  (`moduleFinite_quotient_span_section`, empty pieces are subsingleton), and the
  (c2) rank is the CRT degree identity against `deg K D = n`
  (`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_of_deg`).
* The DivScheme-point corollary consumes `DivFam.toZar` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyZar.lean`)
  and the landed `divRepClassifyZar` (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZar.lean`) verbatim.
-/

/-- **(c1)-finiteness over a field, for an arbitrary adaptation**: each chart-local
colength module `Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_j)` is a finite `K`-module — the chart colength
reading (`moduleFinite_quotient_span_section`) on a nonempty piece, and the zero ring
on an empty piece. -/
theorem moduleFinite_colength (j : A.index) : Module.Finite K (A.colength j) := by
  by_cases hη : genericPoint (relCurve C K) ∈ A.pieces j
  · exact moduleFinite_quotient_span_section K (A.isAffineOpen_pieces j) hη
      (A.eqn_ne_zero j hη)
  · have hbot : A.pieces j ≤ ⊥ :=
      fun x hx => hη (Scheme.genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty ⟨x, hx⟩)
    haveI : Subsingleton Γ(relCurve C K, A.pieces j) :=
      (relCurve C K).subsingleton_sections_of_le_bot hbot
    haveI : Subsingleton (A.colength j) :=
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (I := Ideal.span {A.eqn j})).subsingleton
    haveI : Finite (A.colength j) := Finite.of_subsingleton
    exact Module.Finite.of_finite

/-- **The field certificate of an arbitrary adaptation** (the B-3 deviation of record,
superseding the worksheet's support-separated route): over the field `K`, an adaptation
of a system whose divisor has degree `n` is certified in degree `n`.  Every module over
`K` is free, so (c1)-projectivity and the flat-cokernel clauses (c3)/(c4) are instances;
(c1)-finiteness is `moduleFinite_colength`; and the (c2) rank is the unconditional CRT
colength↔degree identity (`DivisorAdaptation.deg_presentationDivisor`, I-0230) read
against the degree hypothesis. -/
theorem isCertified_of_deg {n : ℕ}
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K
      (Scheme.presentationDivisor K d.presentation) = (n : ℤ)) :
    A.IsCertified n := by
  haveI hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite K (A.colength j) := A.moduleFinite_colength
  haveI : Module.Finite K A.chartProd := Module.Finite.pi
  haveI : Module.Finite K A.Glued := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Free K A.Glued := Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
  have hfr : finrank K A.Glued = n := by
    have hZ := A.deg_presentationDivisor
    rw [hdeg] at hZ
    exact_mod_cast hZ.symm
  refine
    { finite_colength := hfin
      projective_colength := fun j =>
        haveI : Module.Free K (A.colength j) := Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
        inferInstance
      finite_glued := inferInstance
      projective_glued := inferInstance
      rankAtStalk_glued := fun p => ?_
      flat_coker_incl :=
        haveI : Module.Free K (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) :=
          Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
        inferInstance
      flat_coker_diff :=
        haveI : Module.Free K
            (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) :=
          Module.Free.of_divisionRing _ _
        inferInstance }
  simp [hfr]

end DivisorAdaptation

/-! ## The `hsurj` completion and the unconditional field dictionary -/

variable {n : ℕ}

/-- **COV-4, the `hsurj` completion** (★ B-3 keystone, worksheet §1.7): over the field
`K`, every effective Weil divisor `D` of degree `n` on the relative curve is the divisor
of a certified divisor family.  The anchor equations are the point-uniformizer product
of the landed backward realization (`exists_localEquations_presentationDivisor_eq`);
any extraction adaptation (`exists_divisorAdaptation`) carries the field certificate
(`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_of_deg`, via the unconditional CRT degree identity). -/
theorem exists_divFam_divFamDivisor_eq (D : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K D = (n : ℤ)) :
    ∃ F : DivFam C K π n, divFamDivisor F = D := by
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ :=
    Scheme.LocalEquations.exists_localEquations_presentationDivisor_eq K D hD
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := exists_divisorAdaptation C K π E
  refine ⟨DivFam.mk ⟨E, A, A.isCertified_of_deg (by rw [hE]; exact hdeg)⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [divFamDivisor_mk]
  exact hE

/-- **The field dictionary, unconditional** (the frozen `divFamFieldEquiv` of
`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 (f), both named gaps discharged): certified divisor families
of degree `n` over the field `K` are exactly the effective degree-`n` Weil divisors.
`hdeg` is the landed CRT identity (`deg_divFamDivisor`, I-0230); `hsurj` is the B-3
keystone above. -/
noncomputable def divFamFieldEquiv :
    DivFam C K π n ≃
      {D : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor //
        0 ≤ D ∧ Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K D = (n : ℤ)} :=
  divFamFieldEquivOfDegOfSurj (fun F => deg_divFamDivisor F)
    (fun D hD hdeg => exists_divFam_divFamDivisor_eq D hD hdeg)

@[simp]
lemma divFamFieldEquiv_apply (F : DivFam C K π n) :
    (divFamFieldEquiv F : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor) = divFamDivisor F :=
  rfl

end Certificate

117	      (X.mem_basicOpen _ y hy').mp hx'
118	    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := d.ratio_isUnit x x'
119	    have hyW : y ∈ d.cover.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x' := ⟨hy, hy'⟩
120	    have h := congrArg
121	      ((X.presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x') y hyW).hom) hu
122	    rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at h
123	    rw [h, IsUnit.mul_iff]
124	    exact ⟨u.isUnit.map _, hu'⟩
125	  · intro h
126	    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, (X.mem_basicOpen _ y hy).mpr h⟩
127	
128	/-- **The support locus** of a local-equation system: the closed set of points where
129	the (well-defined) germ of the local equation fails to be a unit — the underlying set
130	of the divisor cut by `d`. -/
131	def supportLocus : Set X := (d.unitLocus : Set X)ᶜ
132	
133	lemma isClosed_supportLocus : IsClosed d.supportLocus :=
134	  d.unitLocus.isOpen.isClosed_compl
135	
136	lemma mem_supportLocus_iff_not_isUnit_germ {x y : X} (hy : y ∈ d.cover.opens x) :
137	    y ∈ d.supportLocus
138	      ↔ ¬ IsUnit ((X.presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens x) y hy).hom (d.eqn x)) :=
139	  not_congr (d.mem_unitLocus_iff_isUnit_germ hy)
140	
141	/-- **The per-member trace of the support**: on a covering member, the support locus is
142	the member minus the basic open of its equation. -/
143	lemma supportLocus_inter_opens (x : X) :
144	    d.supportLocus ∩ (d.cover.opens x : Set X)
145	      = (d.cover.opens x : Set X) \ (X.basicOpen (d.eqn x) : Set X) := by
146	  ext y
147	  constructor
148	  · rintro ⟨hsupp, hy⟩
149	    refine ⟨hy, fun hyb => hsupp (d.basicOpen_le_unitLocus x hyb)⟩
150	  · rintro ⟨hy, hyb⟩
151	    refine ⟨fun hyU => hyb ?_, hy⟩
152	    exact (X.mem_basicOpen _ y hy).mpr ((d.mem_unitLocus_iff_isUnit_germ hy).mp hyU)
153	
154	/-- **The support is closed over the base**: the image of the support locus under a
155	universally closed morphism (e.g. the structure morphism of the relative curve, from
156	the standing `IsProper C.hom`) is closed. -/
157	theorem isClosed_image_supportLocus (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f] :
158	    IsClosed (f.base '' d.supportLocus) :=
159	  f.isClosedMap _ d.isClosed_supportLocus
160	
161	/-- **The support tube** (piece isolation, Zariski-locally on the base): for a
162	universally closed `f : X ⟶ S`, if the support fibre over a base point `s` is contained
163	in an open `U` (a union of adaptation pieces, in the DDR-4 instantiation), then there
164	is a Zariski neighbourhood `V` of `s` such that the whole support over `V` is contained
165	in `U`. -/
166	theorem exists_supportTube (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f] {U : Set X}
167	    (hU : IsOpen U) {s : S} (hfib : f.base ⁻¹' {s} ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ U) :
168	    ∃ V : S.Opens, s ∈ V ∧ f.base ⁻¹' (V : Set S) ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ U := by
169	  obtain ⟨V, hVopen, hsV, hV⟩ := (f.isClosedMap).exists_isOpen_preimage_inter_subset
170	    d.isClosed_supportLocus hU hfib
171	  exact ⟨⟨V, hVopen⟩, hsV, hV⟩
172	
173	end Scheme.LocalEquations

175	/-! ## The licence: properness of the relative curve over an arbitrary test ring -/
176	
177	section RelCurveProper
178	
179	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
180	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
181	
182	/-- **Base change of properness to an arbitrary test ring**: the second projection of
183	`C ⊗ Spec R` is proper, for every commutative `k`-algebra `R` — the general-`R` form of
184	`Curve/BaseChangeInstances.instIsProperSndLeft` (which is keyed on field extensions).
185	This is the DDR-4 support-tube licence over the `Z(♦)`-chart rings `R_Z`. -/
186	instance instIsProperRelSndLeft : IsProper (snd C (overSpec k R)).left :=
187	  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsProper)
188	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k R)) inferInstance
189	
190	/-- The properness instance, keyed on the `relCurve C R ↘ Spec R` spelling installed by
191	`relCurve.instOver` (definitionally the second projection). In particular
192	`UniversallyClosed (relCurve C R ↘ Spec R)` fires by resolution, which is what
193	`Scheme.LocalEquations.exists_supportTube` consumes. -/
194	instance instIsProperRelCurveHom :
195	    IsProper ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) :=
196	  inferInstanceAs (IsProper (snd C (overSpec k R)).left)
197	
198	/-- Acceptance smoke test: the support tube applies to the relative curve over an
199	arbitrary test ring with the universally-closed instance found by resolution. -/
200	private theorem supportTube_smoke (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
201	    {U : Set (relCurve C R)} (hU : IsOpen U) {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of R)}
202	    (hfib : ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s} ∩ d.supportLocus
203	      ⊆ U) :
204	    ∃ V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens, s ∈ V ∧
205	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).base ⁻¹' (V : Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
206	        ∩ d.supportLocus ⊆ U :=
207	  d.exists_supportTube _ hU hfib
208	
209	end RelCurveProper

211	/-! ## The adaptation reads the same support, and the (c1) junction -/
212	
213	section Adaptation
214	
215	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
216	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
217	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k}
218	
219	namespace FinCoverData
220	
221	variable [IsFinite π] (D : FinCoverData C R π)
222	
223	/-- **Flatness of the piece section rings over the test ring**: each `Γ(D(h_j))` is a
224	localization of a pinned-chart ring, which is free over `R`; the `FinCoverData`
225	companion of `ThetaGeneratorSeed.flat_sections_piece`. -/
226	theorem flat_sections_pieces (j : D.index) :
227	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) := by
228	  cases j with
229	  | inl j =>
230	      exact flat_sections_basicOpen R (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
231	        (flat_sections_relPinnedChart C R π false) (D.h₀ j)
232	  | inr j =>
233	      exact flat_sections_basicOpen R (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
234	        (flat_sections_relPinnedChart C R π true) (D.h₁ j)
235	
236	end FinCoverData
237	
238	namespace DivisorAdaptation
239	
240	variable [IsAffineHom π] {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
241	variable (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
242	
243	/-- On a piece, the germ of the adaptation equation is a unit iff the germ of `d`'s
244	tautological equation is (the pointwise refinement clause `eqn_rel`, read at germs). -/
245	lemma isUnit_germ_eqn_iff (j : A.index) {w : relCurve C R} (hwj : w ∈ A.pieces j) :
246	    IsUnit (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j) w hwj).hom (A.eqn j))
247	      ↔ IsUnit (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens w) w
248	          (d.cover.mem_opens w)).hom (d.eqn w)) := by
249	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := A.eqn_rel j w
250	  have hwW : w ∈ A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens w := ⟨hwj, d.cover.mem_opens w⟩
251	  have h := congrArg
252	    (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens w) w hwW).hom) hu
253	  rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at h
254	  rw [h, IsUnit.mul_iff]
255	  exact and_iff_right (u.isUnit.map _)
256	
257	/-- On a piece, membership in `d`'s unit locus is membership in the basic open of the
258	adaptation equation. -/
259	lemma mem_basicOpen_eqn_iff_mem_unitLocus (j : A.index) {w : relCurve C R}
260	    (hwj : w ∈ A.pieces j) :
261	    w ∈ (relCurve C R).basicOpen (A.eqn j) ↔ w ∈ d.unitLocus := by
262	  rw [(relCurve C R).mem_basicOpen _ w hwj, A.isUnit_germ_eqn_iff j hwj]
263	  exact (d.mem_unitLocus_iff_isUnit_germ (d.cover.mem_opens w)).symm
264	
265	/-- The adaptation's basic opens land in `d`'s unit locus. -/
266	lemma basicOpen_eqn_le_unitLocus (j : A.index) :
267	    (relCurve C R).basicOpen (A.eqn j) ≤ d.unitLocus := fun _ hw =>
268	  (A.mem_basicOpen_eqn_iff_mem_unitLocus j
269	    ((relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (A.eqn j) hw)).mp hw
270	
271	/-- **The adaptation computes the unit locus**: the union of the basic opens of the
272	adaptation equations IS `d`'s unit locus (so the adaptation and the system cut the same
273	support). Uses that the pieces cover the relative curve (`exists_mem_pieces`). -/
274	lemma iSup_basicOpen_eqn_eq_unitLocus :
275	    (⨆ j, (relCurve C R).basicOpen (A.eqn j)) = d.unitLocus := by
276	  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun j => A.basicOpen_eqn_le_unitLocus j) ?_
277	  intro w hw
278	  obtain ⟨j, hwj⟩ := A.toFinCoverData.exists_mem_pieces w
279	  exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨j, (A.mem_basicOpen_eqn_iff_mem_unitLocus j hwj).mpr hw⟩
280	
281	/-- **The per-piece trace of the family support**: on the piece `D(h_j)`, the support
282	locus of the family is exactly `D(h_j) \ D(f_j)` — the underlying set of the colength
283	`Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_j)`. This is the shape the DDR-4 finiteness argument consumes: the
284	piece trace of the globally closed (and, over the base, properly closed) support. -/
285	lemma supportLocus_inter_pieces (j : A.index) :
286	    d.supportLocus ∩ (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))
287	      = (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))
288	        \ ((relCurve C R).basicOpen (A.eqn j) : Set (relCurve C R)) := by
289	  ext w
290	  constructor
291	  · rintro ⟨hsupp, hwj⟩
292	    exact ⟨hwj, fun hwb => hsupp (A.basicOpen_eqn_le_unitLocus j hwb)⟩
293	  · rintro ⟨hwj, hwb⟩
294	    exact ⟨fun hwU => hwb ((A.mem_basicOpen_eqn_iff_mem_unitLocus j hwj).mpr hwU), hwj⟩
295	
296	end DivisorAdaptation
297	
298	namespace DivisorAdaptation

300	/-! ### The (c1) junction: flat, then finite projective, colengths -/
301	
302	section Junction
303	
304	variable [IsFinite π] {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
305	variable (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
306	
307	/-- **The (c1) flatness clause from fibrewise regularity** (the `SlicingFlat` keystone
308	on the piece ring): if the adaptation equation `f_j` is a nonzerodivisor in every
309	residue-field fibre `Γ(D(h_j)) ⊗ κ(p)`, then the chart-local colength
310	`Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_j)` is flat over the Noetherian test ring. The fibrewise hypothesis is
311	the seed's `fibre_regular` clause transported through `eqn_rel` (the I-0203 open
312	transport item). -/
313	theorem flat_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField [IsNoetherianRing R]
314	    (j : A.index)
315	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
316	      (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
317	          Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
318	        nonZeroDivisors
319	          (Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
320	    Module.Flat R (A.colength j) := by
321	  haveI : Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) :=
322	    A.toFinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces j
323	  exact Module.Flat.quotient_span_singleton_of_forall_tmul_residueField hfib
324	
325	/-- **The certificate clause (c1) for the piece `j`**: fibrewise-regular equation +
326	finite colength (the support-tube finiteness input) ⟹ the colength is finite
327	projective over the Noetherian test ring — `IsCertified.finite_colength` and
328	`IsCertified.projective_colength` at `j`. -/
329	theorem projective_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField [IsNoetherianRing R]
330	    (j : A.index)
331	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
332	      (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
333	          Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
334	        nonZeroDivisors
335	          (Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
336	    [Module.Finite R (A.colength j)] :
337	    Module.Projective R (A.colength j) := by
338	  haveI : Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) :=
339	    A.toFinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces j
340	  exact Module.Projective.quotient_span_singleton_of_forall_tmul_residueField hfib
341	
342	end Junction
343	
344	end DivisorAdaptation
